## Discover India with Aman

India's diverse landscapes and vibrant traditions provide a platform for experiences that resonate long after the journey ends. Here, discovery goes beyond, offering full immersion into a new way of life. Whether exploring the natural beauty of Rajasthan with a commitment to conservation, supporting local communities or connecting with the fascinating history and spirituality of this remarkable region, each encounter is enriching for body, mind and soul.

Travel back in time at palatial [Amanbagh](https://www.aman.com/resorts/amanbagh "Amanbagh"), once a royal hunting ground, or traverse the untamed wilds surrounding [Aman-i-Khás](https://www.aman.com/resorts/aman-i-khas "Aman-i-Khas"), Aman’s two properties in India serve as unrivalled bases for unforgettable adventures.

![Amanbagh's main building reflected in the pool, with arched colonnades and warm stone architecture framed by trees.](https://www.aman.com/sites/default/files/styles/listing_teaser_small/public/2023-01/Amanbagh%2C%20India%20-%20Main%20Building%2C%20Pool%20View-2.webp?itok=E5qZ8f0o)

![Chhatri dinner pavilion at Amanbagh, illuminated at dusk in a mustard field with mountains beyond.](https://www.aman.com/sites/default/files/styles/listing_teaser_small/public/2023-03/Amanbagh-Experience-Chhatri-Dinner.webp?itok=uCpwx7OF)

### Featured exclusive offer

## Camp and Oasis Journey

Experience Rajasthan with a six-night stay at [Amanbagh](https://www.aman.com/resorts/amanbagh "Amanbagh") and [Aman-i-Khás](https://www.aman.com/resorts/aman-i-khas). This full-board journey includes an unforgettable activity of your choice at each resort, from tiger safaris and fort exploration, to cow dust tours, spa treatments, trekking and alfresco private dining.

[Discover more](https://www.aman.com/resorts/aman-i-khas/exclusives/camp-and-oasis-journey)
